title: feat(service-settings): Setup → AI takes several providers, a model list each, one default and one structured-output model
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSH5VNV5CG7X8iMbPHYZ6PJm)_

Fixes #37683

## What changes

Setup → AI (`ai` settings namespace, `packages/services/service-settings`) goes from "pick one provider" to several providers at once. Only existing specifier kinds are used (`select`, `toggle`, `text`, `textarea`, `password`, `action_button`); no `packages/spec` change.

- **Providers on/off.** `provider` keeps its key and stored values and becomes the **default provider**, always on. Every other provider gets a `<provider>_enabled` toggle in the Providers section (hidden for the default provider). Each provider section shows while it is the default or turned on (`${data.provider === 'x' || data.x_enabled === true}`).
- **A model list per provider.** `<provider>_model` stays the provider's first model; new `<provider>_models` (textarea) lists further ids, one per line (a comma also separates). The gateway and Cloudflare lists keep their `provider/model` pattern per id.
- **Keys unchanged.** One encrypted `password` field per provider, as before; no read echoes a value (pinned at the route).
- **One default model, one structured-output model.** `default_model` (one of the default provider's models; blank = its first model) and `structured_output_provider` + `structured_output_model` (a separate knob; blank provider = the default provider, blank model = that provider's first model).
- **Save rule.** A write predicate on the model keys (`registerAiModelRules`, registered by `SettingsServicePlugin` beside the manifest) judges the state after the whole save and refuses with `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` / `invalid_value`, `constraint.rule` naming the rule: `default_model_not_listed`, `default_model_without_provider`, `structured_output_provider_off`, `structured_output_model_not_listed`, `structured_output_model_without_provider`. A breach is refused once, at the first of its keys the save changes (the chosen model first), so a save that drops the default model from its list is refused at that list. Refusal copy is a module-local table in the eleven platform languages, held by `settings-copy-locale.test.ts`.
- **Test connection per provider.** `test_<provider>` action buttons in each section; the default handler is the `ai/test` form check run for that provider (`aiProviderTestActionHandlers`, in the plugin's default map). The cloud host registers the live handlers over them.
- **Reader for the runtime.** `resolveAiModelConfiguration(values)` (exported with `parseAiModelList`, `aiModelRuleBreaches`, `registerAiModelRules`, `AI_PROVIDERS`) returns the providers that are on with their models, the default model and the structured-output model.
- **Hosted projection.** The new keys and the nine `test_<provider>` actions join the `ai` hidden set in `cloud-managed-settings.ts`; the served set is unchanged.
- Translations for every new group, key, help and action in all eleven bundles; the `provider` group and label now read "Providers" / "Default provider".

## Why

Phase 1 of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 (「第一阶段先能把多个模型配置上」): a private Enterprise deployment can configure several models and the runtime can use them. No tiers, no sentinel values, no per-org keys. Fallback happens only at configuration time (the save rule); the resolver hands the runtime exactly the listed models.

### Legacy values

A deployment that stored `provider` + `<provider>_model` before this reads unchanged, with no data rewrite: that provider on, that model its only model and the default (pinned: stored `provider: deepseek` + `deepseek_model` resolves to one provider, `deepseek-reasoner` default; a provider left at the manifest model resolves to that model). The cloud consumer (`packages/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` `buildAdapterFromValues`, live `ai/test`) still reads `provider` + `<provider>_model` exactly as before, so its boot behaviour does not move until its own card of cloud#5055 adopts `resolveAiModelConfiguration` after a pin move.

### Premise check

Card premise re-run on `origin/main` 6d106a1a: `git grep -n "key: 'provider'" -- packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts` → 1 hit (`:51`). Holds.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## Verification

Local, `packages/services/service-settings` (deps built with `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/service-settings^...'`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` → clean
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` → 77 files, 1538 tests passed
- New pins in `src/manifests/ai.manifest.test.ts` (13): two providers with two models each validate and resolve; a default outside the enabled models is refused with `constraint.rule: 'default_model_not_listed'`; a later list change that drops the default is refused at that list; structured-output provider off / model not listed refused; refusal in the caller's language; legacy single-provider values read as one provider with its model as default; no key value in the GET/PUT answers, and the refusal is `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` at the route; each provider's test handler checks that provider; the plugin registers the rule on every model key and the per-provider handlers.
- `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` corpus count 83 → 110 (27 new predicates: toggle, list and test button per provider), with the reason in place.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 72 derived, 70 run with exit 0, 2 NOT-MEASURED on their own prerequisite refusal (exit 3: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs the full workspace build; `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` did not reach its verdict in this tree), both left to CI. `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 72/72.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the changed `.ts` files → clean.
- `overlap-check`: merges cleanly with `origin/main`; textual conflict with #37668 (knowledge settings) only in the `visible` corpus count line of `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` (83 → 79 there, 83 → 110 here). Whichever lands second sets it to 106. Not a #5027 / #5024 PR.

## Acceptance notes

- The global "Test connection" (`ai/test`) still tests the default provider; the per-provider buttons sit in each section.
- The console renders `textarea` with no pattern hint; a malformed list id is refused at save with `invalid_format`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
